# .github/workflows/AGENTS.md

These instructions apply to GitHub Actions workflows in this directory.

Also follow `../../AGENTS.md`.

## Native release matrix

Release CI must continue to build the production profiles declared by
`scripts/config.env`.

Each variant must run on a native runner of its own architecture.

Do not make CI negotiate a weaker profile when a runner lacks required capabilities. An
incapable runner must fail.

## Docker architecture

A Docker `--platform` is acceptable only when it is derived from an already verified
native runner and selects that same architecture.

Never use it for foreign-architecture emulation.

## Release completeness

A tagged GitHub Release must not be published as complete unless all required production
variants have succeeded.

Do not publish only one architecture when the contract requires both.

Keep release asset names and per-variant metadata synchronized with `CONTRACT.md` and
`scripts/config.env`.

## Provenance and verification

Provenance verification must happen before build output is uploaded or published.

Do not trust `build-info.json` solely because it was generated by the same job.

Checksum verification must remain part of the release path.

## Build caches

Do not introduce a cache that can bypass source pin verification, source preparation,
native-host checks, compiler/ISA validation, bindings generation, or provenance validation
without demonstrating that the same fail-closed guarantees are preserved.

## Workflow changes

Keep GitHub permissions minimal.

When updating Action versions, runner labels, containers, or release behavior, evaluate
whether the change alters native architecture guarantees, the toolchain/build environment,
artifact contents, provenance, or release trust boundaries.
